events.title: Earnings Estimates Moving Higher for Avnet (AVT): Time to Buy?
events.body: Avnet (AVT) shares have started gaining and might continue moving higher in the near term, as indicated by solid earnings estimate revisions.

events.title: The Bull Case For Avnet (AVT) Could Change Following Mixed Profit Trends Amid Record Q3 Sales
events.body: In late April 2026, Avnet, Inc. reported fiscal third-quarter sales of US$7,119.78 million, up from US$5,315.42 million a year earlier, with net income rising to US$94.33 million and diluted EPS from continuing operations reaching US$1.14.

events.title: Avnet's Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Record Components Sales
events.body: AVT beats Q3 estimates as sales jump 34% to $7.12B, fueled by record Electronic Components performance and broad regional demand.

events.title: Avnet Inc (AVT) Q3 2026 Earnings Call Highlights: Record Sales and Strategic Growth Amid Challenges
events.body: Avnet Inc (AVT) reports a 34% sales increase and improved operating margins, while navigating geopolitical and macroeconomic challenges.
